title: Automations rail: groups follow the app's navigation order, not the labels' alphabet
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `8415d9f11` (after objectui#12454) with HotCRM: the Automations rail groups flows by trigger object and orders the groups by the object label's collation, so the en rail reads Account · Campaign · Campaign Member · Contact · Contract · Forecast · … and the zh rail reads 报价单 · 合同 · 客户 · 联系人 · 任务 · 商机 — pinyin order, unrelated to how the app presents its objects (HotCRM's navigation: Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Quotes, Contracts, Products, then My Work and Activity). The same object is in a different place in each locale.

## Target

1. Groups follow the app's navigation order: the order in which the package's app declares its object entries (first app of the package, groups flattened); objects the navigation does not list come after, by flow count descending, then by label.
2. Flows without a trigger object (screen flows with no bound object, scheduled flows with no scan object) keep their "Other" group last.
3. The order is the same in every locale.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/flowGrouping.ts` and its test, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the rail's group list), tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: with a navigation listing B, A and a flow set on A, B, C, the groups render B, A, C; the order is identical under en and zh labels.
2. Screenshot of the HotCRM rail at 1280 px.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- Grouping rules from objectui#12454 (trigger object derivation) do not change; only the order.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `01244b886`, never merged): [studio-1024-automations-header-truncated.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/studio-1024-automations-header-truncated.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 second review pass: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the Studio pillars and all 43 Setup pages walked in the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en) with a 1280 × 900 re-check (zh). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed, verbatim: 「全部立卡」.</sub>
